description: This file defines a Python module for transforming and configuring embedding requests and responses for the Volcengine API, specifically integrating with OpenAI compatible embedding workflows. It includes a configuration class, methods to construct URLs, map parameters, transform request data, and handle responses.

classes.name: VolcEngineEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Volcengine embedding models, providing methods for URL construction, parameter mapping, request transformation, response parsing, and environment validation.

methods.name: get_config(cls)
methods.description: Returns the configuration for the class, possibly inherited from the base class.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters that can be used with Volcengine embedding models.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for Volcengine embedding requests based on base URL and endpoint.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: Dict[str, Any], optional_params: Dict[str, Any], model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps standard OpenAI embedding parameters into Volcengine-specific parameters for requests.

methods.name: dict transform_embedding_request( self, model: str, input: AllEmbeddingInputValues, optional_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into the request data format expected by Volcengine API.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse transform_embedding_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: EmbeddingResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_key: Optional[str], request_data: dict, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw HTTP response into an EmbeddingResponse object compatible with OpenAI format.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates the environment, notably ensuring required headers like API key are present, and returns headers for the request.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Generates an error class instance for handling API errors specific to Volcengine.
